holdoutEligibility.rule: No final acceptance decision may be issued while attempt-4 coverage is incomplete (fewer than 12 completed PROMPT_V5_CANONICAL logical evaluations) or while any stop condition is unresolved. HOLDOUT stays forbidden until a DEV candidate passes every frozen gate.

scope: This summary concerns the DEVELOPMENT split only. It is a report of measured gate outcomes, not an acceptance decision; it authorises no HOLDOUT inference, no merge to main, no further attempt and no production change. HOLDOUT requires a separate owner authorisation.
